entries.definition_en: to eat the meal in the middle of the day
entries.example_en: We have lunch at school at eleven.
entries.example_vi: Chúng mình ăn trưa ở trường lúc mười một giờ.

entries.definition_en: to eat the meal in the evening
entries.example_en: My family has dinner at seven o'clock.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình ăn tối lúc bảy giờ.

entries.definition_en: to eat the first meal of the day
entries.example_en: I have breakfast with bread and milk.
entries.example_vi: Mình ăn sáng bằng bánh mì và sữa.

entries.definition_en: a hot drink made with dry leaves and water
entries.example_en: My grandpa drinks green tea every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào ông mình cũng uống trà xanh.

entries.definition_en: to make food hot and ready to eat
entries.example_en: My dad cooks fish soup on Sundays.
entries.example_vi: Chủ nhật bố mình nấu canh cá.

entries.definition_en: rice cooked in a pan with oil and egg
entries.example_en: My mom makes fried rice on Sunday.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ mình làm cơm chiên vào Chủ nhật.

entries.definition_en: words you say when you want to eat
entries.example_en: I'm hungry. Let's eat pho now.
entries.example_vi: Mình đói rồi. Mình đi ăn phở đi.

entries.definition_en: an animal that lives in water, eaten as food
entries.example_en: We eat rice and fish for dinner.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình ăn cơm với cá vào bữa tối.

entries.definition_en: a drink made from oranges
entries.example_en: I drink orange juice every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào mình cũng uống nước cam.

entries.definition_en: an amount in a small cup
entries.example_en: My dad drinks a cup of tea after lunch.
entries.example_vi: Bố mình uống một tách trà sau bữa trưa.

entries.definition_en: things that people and animals eat
entries.example_en: The food at this market is cheap and good.
entries.example_vi: Đồ ăn ở chợ này rẻ mà ngon.

entries.definition_en: an amount in a glass
entries.example_en: Can I have a glass of water, please?
entries.example_vi: Cho mình xin một ly nước nhé?

entries.definition_en: a white drink that comes from cows
entries.example_en: I drink a glass of milk before bed.
entries.example_vi: Mình uống một ly sữa trước khi ngủ.

entries.definition_en: to put food in your mouth and have it
entries.example_en: We eat rice with fish and vegetables.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình ăn cơm với cá và rau.

entries.definition_en: small white grains that people cook and eat
entries.example_en: Vietnamese people eat rice every day.
entries.example_vi: Người Việt ăn cơm hằng ngày.

entries.definition_en: a round fruit with red or green skin
entries.example_en: Mai eats an apple after lunch.
entries.example_vi: Mai ăn một quả táo sau bữa trưa.

entries.definition_en: a food that comes from a chicken
entries.example_en: My mom buys ten eggs at the market.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ mình mua mười quả trứng ở chợ.

entries.definition_en: a food made from flour and baked in an oven
entries.example_en: We buy hot bread from the shop near school.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình mua bánh mì nóng ở tiệm gần trường.

entries.definition_en: something you drink, like water or juice
entries.example_en: Can I have a cold drink, please?
entries.example_vi: Cho mình xin một ly nước lạnh nhé.

entries.definition_en: to take water or another liquid into your mouth
entries.example_en: Drink a lot of water on hot days.
entries.example_vi: Ngày nóng nhớ uống nhiều nước nhé.

entries.definition_en: food that grows on trees or plants, like apples
entries.example_en: My mom buys fresh fruit at the market.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ mình mua hoa quả tươi ở chợ.

entries.definition_en: the meal you eat in the middle of the day
entries.example_en: We eat lunch at school at eleven thirty.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình ăn trưa ở trường lúc mười một rưỡi.

entries.definition_en: the clear liquid in rivers and rain that you drink
entries.example_en: I drink two bottles of water every day.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi ngày mình uống hai chai nước.

entries.definition_en: a long, curved yellow fruit
entries.example_en: The monkeys at the zoo love bananas.
entries.example_vi: Những chú khỉ ở sở thú rất thích chuối.

entries.definition_en: a hot or cold drink made from brown beans
entries.example_en: My dad drinks iced coffee every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào bố mình cũng uống cà phê đá.

entries.definition_en: the main meal you eat in the evening
entries.example_en: Dinner is ready! Come and eat.
entries.example_vi: Cơm tối xong rồi! Vào ăn thôi.

entries.definition_en: wanting to eat food
entries.example_en: The baby cries when he is hungry.
entries.example_vi: Em bé khóc khi bị đói.

entries.definition_en: the meat of a chicken, eaten as food
entries.example_en: Grandma cooks chicken soup when I am sick.
entries.example_vi: Bà nấu súp gà mỗi khi mình bị ốm.

entries.definition_en: the first meal of the day
entries.example_en: I eat pho for breakfast on Sunday.
entries.example_vi: Chủ nhật mình ăn phở vào bữa sáng.

entries.definition_en: a plant you eat, like a carrot or cabbage
entries.example_en: Eat your vegetables. They are good for you.
entries.example_vi: Ăn rau đi con. Rau tốt cho sức khỏe đấy.

entries.definition_en: a place where you buy and eat a meal
entries.example_en: We go to a seafood restaurant for Dad's birthday.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đi nhà hàng hải sản mừng sinh nhật bố.

entries.definition_en: a small round container with a handle for drinks
entries.example_en: This cup is too hot to hold.
entries.example_vi: Cái cốc này nóng quá, không cầm được.

entries.definition_en: to make something into pieces with a knife
entries.example_en: Mom cuts the cake into eight pieces.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ cắt bánh thành tám miếng.

entries.definition_en: a round, deep dish for soup or rice
entries.example_en: I eat two bowls of rice at dinner.
entries.example_vi: Bữa tối mình ăn hai bát cơm.

entries.definition_en: a small place where you can buy drinks and simple food
entries.example_en: Lan and I meet at a cafe after class.
entries.example_vi: Lan và mình gặp nhau ở quán cà phê sau giờ học.

entries.definition_en: a sweet food made from flour, eggs and sugar
entries.example_en: Mom makes a chocolate cake for my birthday.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ làm bánh sô-cô-la cho sinh nhật mình.

entries.definition_en: the food you eat at one time, like lunch
entries.example_en: We have three meals a day.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi ngày tụi mình ăn ba bữa.

entries.definition_en: the part of an animal that people eat
entries.example_en: My brother does not eat meat.
entries.example_vi: Anh mình không ăn thịt.

entries.definition_en: a hot liquid food made with vegetables or meat
entries.example_en: Vietnamese families often eat soup with rice.
entries.example_vi: Các gia đình Việt thường ăn canh với cơm.

entries.definition_en: a small sweet food made with sugar
entries.example_en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.
entries.example_vi: Ăn nhiều kẹo không tốt cho răng.

entries.definition_en: a cup made of glass, with no handle
entries.example_en: Please put the glasses on the table.
entries.example_vi: Con đặt mấy cái ly lên bàn nhé.

entries.definition_en: a drink made from fruit or vegetables
entries.example_en: I like apple juice with ice.
entries.example_vi: Mình thích nước ép táo có đá.

entries.definition_en: a flat round bread with cheese and tomato on top
entries.example_en: We order a big pizza on Friday night.
entries.example_vi: Tối thứ Sáu tụi mình gọi một cái pizza to.

entries.definition_en: tasting of sugar
entries.example_en: These bananas are very sweet.
entries.example_vi: Mấy quả chuối này ngọt lắm.

entries.definition_en: a tall container for drinks, often made of glass or plastic
entries.example_en: Take a bottle of water to school.
entries.example_vi: Mang theo một chai nước đến trường nhé.

entries.definition_en: a small, flat, sweet cake
entries.example_en: Grandma bakes cookies for us on weekends.
entries.example_vi: Cuối tuần bà nướng bánh quy cho tụi mình.

entries.definition_en: a round, sweet fruit with a thick orange skin
entries.example_en: I eat an orange every day in winter.
entries.example_vi: Mùa đông ngày nào mình cũng ăn một quả cam.

entries.definition_en: a round vegetable that grows under the ground
entries.example_en: Mom fries potatoes for dinner.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ chiên khoai tây cho bữa tối.

entries.definition_en: a soft, round red fruit used as a vegetable
entries.example_en: We put tomatoes in the soup.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình cho cà chua vào nồi canh.

entries.definition_en: two pieces of bread with food between them
entries.example_en: I take a cheese sandwich to school.
entries.example_vi: Mình mang bánh sandwich phô mai đến trường.

entries.definition_en: a sweet brown food made from cocoa
entries.example_en: My little brother loves chocolate.
entries.example_vi: Em trai mình mê sô-cô-la.

entries.definition_en: tasting very good
entries.example_en: The fish soup at this shop is delicious!
entries.example_vi: Canh cá ở quán này ngon quá!

entries.definition_en: a cold, sweet food made from milk
entries.example_en: We eat ice cream on hot days.
entries.example_vi: Ngày nóng tụi mình ăn kem.

entries.definition_en: to put something with something else
entries.example_en: Add some sugar to the coffee.
entries.example_vi: Cho thêm chút đường vào cà phê.

entries.definition_en: a seed that you cook and eat
entries.example_en: Mom cooks green beans for dinner.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ nấu đậu que cho bữa tối.

entries.definition_en: meat from a cow
entries.example_en: Pho with beef is my favorite breakfast.
entries.example_vi: Phở bò là bữa sáng mình thích nhất.

entries.definition_en: a person who makes food, often as a job
entries.example_en: My aunt is a cook at a hotel.
entries.example_vi: Dì mình làm đầu bếp ở một khách sạn.

entries.definition_en: a tall plant with yellow seeds that you can eat
entries.example_en: We buy hot corn at the night market.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình mua bắp nướng ở chợ đêm.

entries.definition_en: food cooked in a special way as part of a meal
entries.example_en: Fried rice is an easy dish to make.
entries.example_vi: Cơm chiên là món dễ làm.

entries.definition_en: having eaten enough food
entries.example_en: No more rice, thanks. I am full.
entries.example_vi: Thôi, cảm ơn, mình no rồi.

entries.definition_en: the thick white part on top of milk
entries.example_en: I like my coffee with cream.
entries.example_vi: Mình thích uống cà phê với kem tươi.

entries.definition_en: a small round green or purple fruit
entries.example_en: We eat grapes after dinner.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình ăn nho sau bữa tối.

entries.definition_en: a tool with a sharp edge for cutting
entries.example_en: Be careful with that knife. It is sharp.
entries.example_vi: Cẩn thận con dao đó, nó sắc lắm.

entries.definition_en: cold vegetables mixed together
entries.example_en: Mom makes a salad with tomatoes and eggs.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ làm món trộn với cà chua và trứng.

entries.definition_en: what you notice with your nose
entries.example_en: I love the smell of fresh bread.
entries.example_vi: Mình thích mùi bánh mì mới ra lò.

entries.definition_en: a sweet white food you add to drinks and cakes
entries.example_en: Do you want sugar in your tea?
entries.example_vi: Bạn có muốn cho đường vào trà không?

entries.definition_en: a soft yellow food made from milk
entries.example_en: Put some butter on your bread.
entries.example_vi: Phết chút bơ lên bánh mì đi.

entries.definition_en: a food made from milk, often yellow or white
entries.example_en: My sister puts cheese on everything.
entries.example_vi: Chị mình món gì cũng cho phô mai.

entries.definition_en: a man who brings food to tables in a restaurant
entries.example_en: The waiter brings us two bowls of soup.
entries.example_vi: Anh phục vụ mang cho tụi mình hai bát canh.

entries.definition_en: a thick food made from milk, often eaten cold
entries.example_en: I eat yogurt after lunch every day.
entries.example_vi: Ngày nào mình cũng ăn sữa chua sau bữa trưa.

entries.definition_en: a round bread with cooked meat inside
entries.example_en: The kids want hamburgers for lunch.
entries.example_vi: Bọn trẻ muốn ăn hamburger vào bữa trưa.

entries.definition_en: a large bird, or its meat eaten as food
entries.example_en: A turkey is a big bird, and its meat is good.
entries.example_vi: Gà tây là loài chim lớn, thịt rất ngon.

entries.definition_en: a small, dry, crisp cake, often sweet
entries.example_en: Grandpa eats a biscuit with his tea.
entries.example_vi: Ông ăn một chiếc bánh quy với trà.

entries.definition_en: a woman who brings food to tables in a restaurant
entries.example_en: The waitress gives us the menu.
entries.example_vi: Chị phục vụ đưa thực đơn cho tụi mình.
